svg.title: How plug-in atoms reach the truth on a real law
svg.desc: On a binned occupancy law with 16 cells, rare cells appear late, the four net atoms of one sample path converge, and the distance to the population falls below the uniform envelope.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
